createTask.title: Release-nyhed: <version>
createTask.description:
---
source: "release-news"
repo: "<owner>/<repo>"
version: "<x.y.z>"
tag: "v<x.y.z>"
releases_file: "tickets/releases.json"
tickets_dir: "tickets"
check: "node tickets/tools/check-releases.mjs"
run_url: ""
event: "manual"
---

Håndoprettet kort. Normalt opretter workflowet `alp-release-news.yml` kortet, når en release er lagt ud; brug denne form for at skrive nyheden til én bestemt version.
